column1: # Golden Sun (USA, Europe) tbs-en address map, from alchemy 24b72a32 built by tools/build_ref.sh.
# Addresses and names only (no ROM bytes). check: rom = section byte-identical to the player's ROM;
# standin-xref / standin-offset = object built by a stand-in compiler, address from cross-references
# class: code = only code; data = no code (assets/tables: bound to ROM addresses, never compiled);
# mixed = code plus data sections (compile the code, bind the data symbols to the ROM).
